mapper.select:
SELECT ID AS USER_ID, NAME AS USER_NM, LEVEL_NM AS POSITION_NM, EMP_NO AS EMP_NO, DEPT_ID AS DEPT_ID, DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT C.ID, C.NAME, L.LEVEL_NM, C.EMP_NO, D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NM FROM TB_CM06M01 C LEFT JOIN TB_CM04M01 D ON C.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CM07M01 L ON C.LEVEL_CD = L.LEVEL_CD WHERE 1 = 1
AND C.DEPT_ID LIKE #{deptId} || '%'
AND C.DEPT_ID LIKE 'GUN60%'
AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.NAME ASC ) WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT RSV_NO AS RSV_NO, CO_CD AS CO_CD, USER_ID AS USER_ID, (SELECT NAME FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE ID = TB_PM60M01.USER_ID) AS USER_NM, TRIP_DIV AS TRIP_DIV, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_DIV) AS TRIP_DIV_NM, TRIP_TYPE_CDS AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_TYPE_CDS) AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS_NM, TRIP_COND_CD AS TRIP_COND_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_COND_CD) AS TRIP_COND_CD_NM, RSV_STS_CD AS RSV_STS_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(RSV_STS_CD) AS RSV_STS_CD_NM, TRIP_PLACE AS TRIP_PLACE, CLNT_PJT_CD AS CLNT_PJT_CD, CLNT_PJT_NM AS CLNT_PJT_NM, TRIP_ST_DTM AS TRIP_ST_DTM, TRIP_ED_DTM AS TRIP_ED_DTM, SUBSTR(TRIP_ST_DTM, 1, 10) AS TRIP_ST_DTM_DISP, SUBSTR(TRIP_ED_DTM, 1, 10) AS TRIP_ED_DTM_DISP, NIGHT_CNT AS NIGHT_CNT, DAY_CNT AS DAY_CNT, ETC AS ETC, TRIP_REQ_NO AS TRIP_REQ_NO, CREAT_ID AS CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM AS CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID AS UDT_ID, UDT_DTTM AS UDT_DTTM FROM TB_PM60M01 WHERE CO_CD = 'GUN'
AND USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID LIKE #{deptId} || '%' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
AND USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID LIKE 'GUN60%' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
AND SUBSTR(TRIP_ST_DTM, 1, 8) <= #{monthEdDt} AND SUBSTR(TRIP_ED_DTM, 1, 8) >= #{monthStDt}
ORDER BY USER_ID ASC, TRIP_ST_DTM ASC

SELECT M.TRIP_REQ_NO AS TRIP_REQ_NO, D.USER_ID AS USER_ID, NVL(( SELECT D2.TRIP_ST_DTM FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO WHERE R.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ), D.TRIP_ST_DTM) AS TRIP_ST_DTM, NVL(( SELECT D2.TRIP_ED_DTM FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO WHERE R.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ), D.TRIP_ED_DTM) AS TRIP_ED_DTM, ( SELECT R.TRIP_RPT_NO FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO WHERE R.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS TRIP_RPT_NO, M.TRIP_PLACE AS TRIP_PLACE, M.CLNT_PJT AS CLNT_PJT, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CLNT_PJT) AS CLNT_PJT_NM, M.TRIP_TYPE_CDS AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.TRIP_TYPE_CDS) AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS_NM FROM TB_PM51D01 D INNER JOIN TB_PM51M01 M ON M.TRIP_REQ_NO = D.TRIP_REQ_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND D.USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID LIKE #{deptId} || '%' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
AND D.USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID LIKE 'GUN60%' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
AND SUBSTR( NVL(( SELECT D2.TRIP_ST_DTM FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO WHERE R.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ), D.TRIP_ST_DTM), 1, 8) <= #{monthEdDt} AND SUBSTR( NVL(( SELECT D2.TRIP_ED_DTM FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO WHERE R.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ), D.TRIP_ED_DTM), 1, 8) >= #{monthStDt}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY D.USER_ID ASC, D.TRIP_ST_DTM ASC

SELECT M.REQ_ID AS USER_ID, M.ST_DT AS ST_DT, M.ED_DT AS ED_DT, M.ST_DT AS WORK_RPT_DT, M.VAC_TYPE_CD AS WORK_RPT_S, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.VAC_TYPE_CD) AS WORK_RPT_S_NM, M.REQ_RMK AS REMARK, 'VACATION' AS REC_TYPE, M.REQ_NO AS FILE_TRGT_KEY, M.CO_CD AS CO_CD, M.VAC_DAYS AS VAC_DAYS, M.DEDUCT_DAYS AS DEDUCT_DAYS FROM TB_PM07M01 M WHERE NVL(M.SANCTN_STS, 'TEMP') NOT IN ('TEMP', 'RTN')
AND 1 = 0
AND M.REQ_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID LIKE #{deptId} || '%' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
AND M.REQ_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE DEPT_ID LIKE 'GUN60%' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
AND M.ST_DT <= #{monthEdDt} AND M.ED_DT >= #{monthStDt}
ORDER BY M.REQ_ID ASC, M.ST_DT ASC

SELECT RSV_NO AS RSV_NO, CO_CD AS CO_CD, USER_ID AS USER_ID, (SELECT NAME FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE ID = TB_PM60M01.USER_ID) AS USER_NM, TRIP_DIV AS TRIP_DIV, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_DIV) AS TRIP_DIV_NM, TRIP_TYPE_CDS AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_TYPE_CDS) AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS_NM, TRIP_COND_CD AS TRIP_COND_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(TRIP_COND_CD) AS TRIP_COND_CD_NM, RSV_STS_CD AS RSV_STS_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(RSV_STS_CD) AS RSV_STS_CD_NM, TRIP_PLACE AS TRIP_PLACE, CLNT_PJT_CD AS CLNT_PJT_CD, CLNT_PJT_NM AS CLNT_PJT_NM, TRIP_ST_DTM AS TRIP_ST_DTM, TRIP_ED_DTM AS TRIP_ED_DTM, NIGHT_CNT AS NIGHT_CNT, DAY_CNT AS DAY_CNT, ETC AS ETC, TRIP_REQ_NO AS TRIP_REQ_NO, CREAT_ID AS CREAT_ID, CREAT_DTTM AS CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID AS UDT_ID, UDT_DTTM AS UDT_DTTM FROM TB_PM60M01 WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}

SELECT 'RV' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(TB_PM60M01_SQ01.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PM60M01 ( RSV_NO, CO_CD, USER_ID, TRIP_DIV, TRIP_TYPE_CDS, TRIP_COND_CD, RSV_STS_CD, TRIP_PLACE, CLNT_PJT_CD, CLNT_PJT_NM, TRIP_ST_DTM, TRIP_ED_DTM, NIGHT_CNT, DAY_CNT, ETC, TRIP_REQ_NO, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{rsvNo}, #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripDiv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripTypeCds, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripCondCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rsvStsCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripPlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clntPjtCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clntPjtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripStDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripEdDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nightCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dayCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripReqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM6001P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM60M01 SET USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_DIV = #{tripDiv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_TYPE_CDS = #{tripTypeCds, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_COND_CD = #{tripCondCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RSV_STS_CD = #{rsvStsCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_PLACE = #{tripPlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CLNT_PJT_CD = #{clntPjtCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CLNT_PJT_NM = #{clntPjtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_ST_DTM = #{tripStDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_ED_DTM = #{tripEdDtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NIGHT_CNT = #{nightCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DAY_CNT = #{dayCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ETC = #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_REQ_NO = #{tripReqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM6001P01', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'RV2' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(MOD(TB_PM60M02_SQ01.NEXTVAL, 10000), 4, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PM60M02 ( RSV_NO, CO_CD, CLNT_CD, VNDR_NM, WORKER_NM, WORK_ST_DT, WORK_ED_DT, WORK_DT, WORK_HOUR, TRIP_PLACE, CLNT_PJT_CD, CLNT_PJT_NM, TRIP_TYPE_CDS, TRIP_DIV, TRIP_COND_CD, RSV_STS_CD, NIGHT_CNT, DAY_CNT, ETC, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{rsvNo}, #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clntCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vndrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workerNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workStDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workEdDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workHour, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{tripPlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clntPjtCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clntPjtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripTypeCds, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripDiv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tripCondCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rsvStsCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nightCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dayCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PM6001P01', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PM60M02 SET CLNT_CD = #{clntCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, VNDR_NM = #{vndrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORKER_NM = #{workerNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_ST_DT = #{workStDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_ED_DT = #{workEdDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_DT = #{workDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WORK_HOUR = #{workHour, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TRIP_PLACE = #{tripPlace, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CLNT_PJT_CD = #{clntPjtCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CLNT_PJT_NM = #{clntPjtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_TYPE_CDS = #{tripTypeCds, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_DIV = #{tripDiv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRIP_COND_CD = #{tripCondCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RSV_STS_CD = #{rsvStsCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NIGHT_CNT = #{nightCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DAY_CNT = #{dayCnt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ETC = #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_ID = #{creatId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UDT_PGM = 'PM6001P01', UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
mapper.select:
WITH DEPT_MEMBERS AS ( SELECT ID AS USER_ID FROM TB_CM06M01 WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
AND DEPT_ID LIKE #{deptId} || '%'
AND DEPT_ID LIKE 'GUN60%'
), CALENDAR_TBL AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{monthStDt},'YYYYMMDD') + LEVEL - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WORK_DT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (TO_DATE(#{monthEdDt},'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(#{monthStDt},'YYYYMMDD') + 1) ), EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL AS ( SELECT D.USER_ID AS USER_ID, M.TRIP_REQ_NO AS TRIP_REQ_NO, M.TRIP_TYPE_CDS AS TRIP_TYPE_CDS, NVL(D2.TRIP_ST_DTM, D.TRIP_ST_DTM) AS EFF_ST_DTM, NVL(D2.TRIP_ED_DTM, D.TRIP_ED_DTM) AS EFF_ED_DTM FROM TB_PM51D01 D INNER JOIN DEPT_MEMBERS DM ON DM.USER_ID = D.USER_ID INNER JOIN TB_PM51M01 M ON M.TRIP_REQ_NO = D.TRIP_REQ_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R.TRIP_REQ_NO, D2.USER_ID, MIN(D2.TRIP_ST_DTM) AS TRIP_ST_DTM, MAX(D2.TRIP_ED_DTM) AS TRIP_ED_DTM FROM TB_PM52D02 D2 INNER JOIN TB_PM52M01 R ON R.TRIP_RPT_NO = D2.TRIP_RPT_NO GROUP BY R.TRIP_REQ_NO, D2.USER_ID ) D2 ON D2.TRIP_REQ_NO = M.TRIP_REQ_NO AND D2.USER_ID = D.USER_ID ), PLAN_STATS AS ( SELECT C.WORK_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT P.USER_ID) AS PLAN_CNT FROM CALENDAR_TBL C LEFT JOIN TB_PM60M01 P ON P.CO_CD = 'GUN' AND P.TRIP_ST_DTM <= C.WORK_DT || '235959' AND P.TRIP_ED_DTM >= C.WORK_DT || '000000' AND P.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM DEPT_MEMBERS) GROUP BY C.WORK_DT ), REST_STATS AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(M.WORK_RPT_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WORK_DT, M.WORK_RPT_ID AS USER_ID FROM TB_PM01M01 M INNER JOIN DEPT_MEMBERS DM ON DM.USER_ID = M.WORK_RPT_ID WHERE M.WORK_RPT_S LIKE '%9901' AND M.WORK_RPT_DT >= TO_DATE(#{monthStDt}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND M.WORK_RPT_DT <= TO_DATE(#{monthEdDt}, 'YYYYMMDD') ), UNAVAIL_STATS AS ( SELECT C.WORK_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT U.USER_ID) AS UNAVAIL_CNT FROM CALENDAR_TBL C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P.USER_ID, C2.WORK_DT FROM CALENDAR_TBL C2 INNER JOIN TB_PM60M01 P ON P.CO_CD = 'GUN' AND P.TRIP_ST_DTM <= C2.WORK_DT || '235959' AND P.TRIP_ED_DTM >= C2.WORK_DT || '000000' AND P.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM DEPT_MEMBERS) UNION SELECT R.USER_ID, R.WORK_DT FROM REST_STATS R ) U ON U.WORK_DT = C.WORK_DT GROUP BY C.WORK_DT ), ACTUAL_STATS AS ( SELECT C.WORK_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE30' THEN A.USER_ID END) AS INSTALL_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE60' THEN A.USER_ID END) AS PAID_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.TRIP_TYPE_CDS = 'PM51TYPE40' THEN A.USER_ID END) AS FREE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.TRIP_TYPE_CDS NOT IN ('PM51TYPE30', 'PM51TYPE60', 'PM51TYPE40') OR A.TRIP_TYPE_CDS IS NULL THEN A.USER_ID END) AS ETC_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT A.USER_ID) AS ACTUAL_CNT FROM CALENDAR_TBL C LEFT JOIN EFFECTIVE_ACTUAL A ON A.EFF_ST_DTM <= C.WORK_DT || '235959' AND A.EFF_ED_DTM >= C.WORK_DT || '000000' GROUP BY C.WORK_DT ) SELECT C.WORK_DT AS WORK_DT, SUBSTR(C.WORK_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(C.WORK_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(C.WORK_DT, 7, 2) AS WORK_DT_DISP, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEPT_MEMBERS) AS TOTAL_CNT, COALESCE(PS.PLAN_CNT, 0) AS PLAN_CNT, GREATEST(0, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEPT_MEMBERS) - COALESCE(US.UNAVAIL_CNT, 0)) AS AVAIL_CNT, COALESCE(AST.ACTUAL_CNT, 0) AS ACTUAL_CNT, COALESCE(AST.INSTALL_CNT, 0) AS INSTALL_CNT, COALESCE(AST.PAID_CNT, 0) AS PAID_CNT, COALESCE(AST.FREE_CNT, 0) AS FREE_CNT, COALESCE(AST.ETC_CNT, 0) AS ETC_CNT FROM CALENDAR_TBL C LEFT JOIN PLAN_STATS PS ON PS.WORK_DT = C.WORK_DT LEFT JOIN UNAVAIL_STATS US ON US.WORK_DT = C.WORK_DT LEFT JOIN ACTUAL_STATS AST ON AST.WORK_DT = C.WORK_DT ORDER BY C.WORK_DT ASC
